name: Articfly – AI Blog Articles Generator
author: Articfly

sections.description:
Grow Your Blog on Autopilot. In Your Brand Voice.

Articfly is your behind-the-scenes content team powered by AI. It writes SEO articles in your unique brand voice, plans a full month of topics, auto-publishes to your WordPress site, and refreshes old articles before they lose rankings. No writing. No scheduling. No staring at blank pages.

Articfly plugin may embed external links or credits on the public site.

The plugin provides secure API access for the Articfly app to deliver generated articles to your WordPress posts and read them back for analysis and refreshing.

Features

  • Fully automatic content creation — articles arrive as drafts, live posts, or scheduled for any future date and time
  • Brand Voice training — Articfly learns your tone and style from your existing content, so every article sounds like you, not generic AI
  • 30-day content plans — AI generates a full month of topic ideas tailored to your niche, scheduled per day and time
  • Article Refresher — Old articles lose rankings as content goes stale. Articfly scores every post by freshness and rewrites the ones that need updating, automatically
  • Long-form, SEO-optimized articles — Short, medium, and long. Researches top Google results, builds an outline, writes a full article with headings, intro, conclusion, and internal structure
  • Featured images & smart tags — Images downloaded automatically, keywords added as WordPress post tags
  • Rank on Google AND ChatGPT — 10 built-in tools including RAO Score (cite-likelihood for ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini) and AI Content Checker
  • One-click Article Rewriter — Modernize, simplify, expand, or change the tone of any existing article in minutes
  • Page builders supported — Works with Classic Editor, Gutenberg, and Elementor
  • Multi-site ready — One Articfly account across all your WordPress sites

External Services

This plugin connects to the Articfly API to deliver AI-generated articles to your site and sync content for analysis and refreshing.

Data sent:
– Connection Key (generated in the Articfly app, stored by user in plugin settings)
– Site URL, site name, WordPress version, PHP version, plugin version
– Locale and timezone

Data is sent when:
– Articles are delivered via the Articfly API
– The plugin checks subscription status

External Service:
– Articfly API
– Privacy Policy: https://articfly.com/privacy
– Terms of Use: https://articfly.com/terms

The plugin does not include third-party analytics, ad pixels, or behavioral tracking scripts.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/articfly-ai-blog-articles-generator, or install via the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen.
  3. Go to Articfly > Dashboard in your WordPress admin.
  4. Sign up at articfly.com (or log in if you already have an account).
  5. Generate a Connection Key in the Articfly dashboard and paste it in the plugin.
  6. Start generating articles in the web app — they appear in your WordPress site automatically.
sections.faq:
Do I need an Articfly account?

Yes. You need an active Articfly subscription at articfly.com to generate articles.

Where do I generate articles?

All article generation happens in the Articfly web app at app.articfly.com. The WordPress plugin receives and publishes the generated content.

Can I use the same account across multiple WordPress sites?

Yes. For multisite installations and agencies, you can use one Articfly account for all sites in your network.

What happens to articles after generation?

Generated articles are delivered to your WordPress site and saved as posts (draft, published, or scheduled based on your settings). You can edit them like any other post.

Will Articfly write in my brand voice?

Yes. Articfly’s Brand Voice feature reads your existing website and example articles, builds a brand profile, and applies it to every article it generates — so your blog sounds like you, not generic AI.

Is my data secure?

Yes. Connection tokens are encrypted at rest using AES-256-CBC. Article delivery uses HMAC-SHA256 signed webhooks. No visitor data is transmitted.
sections.changelog:
3.0.0

  • Major: Redesigned as gateway plugin — all AI features now in the Articfly web app
  • New: Simplified dashboard with connection status and quick links
  • New: Admin bar integration with quick access to Articfly
  • New: Plugin action links (Dashboard, Settings) on plugins.php
  • New: Admin notification when new article is delivered via webhook
  • New: X-Articfly-Key header for WordPress REST API (avoids JWT Auth conflicts)
  • New: Featured image support in REST API responses
  • Removed: Article generator forms, SEO tools, calendar, rewriter, brand voice UI
  • Security: All legacy features removed — smaller attack surface

1.09

  • Fixed default API URL (migrated from Supabase to VPS backend)
  • Removed user_id from generation payloads (backend derives from token)
  • Brand design refresh: zero border-radius, orange tokens, new typography

1.08

  • Security: plugin_api_key encrypted at rest using AES-256-CBC
  • Security: direct file access guard on all PHP files
  • Stability: transient write lock on jobs, deduplication
  • Cleanup: added uninstall.php for clean removal

1.07

  • Single All-in subscription model
  • Removed legacy standalone flow

1.0.0

  • Initial release
